outcome.answer: Several papers study reinforcement-learning self-play for strategy games. For real-time strategy, Generals.io agents trained with policy-gradient self-play on win/loss rewards achieved superhuman play [1]. For asymmetric board games, an AlphaZero-style approach for Tablut used separate policy and value heads for each player role, with techniques to stabilize training [2]. In hidden-information strategy games, Ataraxos combined self-play reinforcement learning with test-time search to achieve superhuman Stratego play [3].
